---
description: Create an evidence-backed checkpoint for a long investigation or handoff
agent: agent
---

Use the `evidence-checkpoint` skill for this investigation.

Before editing production code:

1. state the investigation question and definition of done;
2. inspect the relevant repository instructions;
3. create or update a structured scratchpad;
4. separate confirmed evidence from hypotheses;
5. cite exact files, line ranges, tests, and commands;
6. split independent research questions into read-only subagent tasks when useful;
7. verify subagent conclusions before accepting them;
8. produce a checkpoint before implementation or handoff.

Do not rely on conversation history as the only record. Do not write production code until the evidence, unresolved questions, and proposed next step are reviewable.
